args.title: payments-api errors after v5.1.0 deploy
args.summary: payments-api v5.1.0 deployed this morning is degraded across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Rolling back to v5.1.0's predecessor v5.0.0, the most recent healthy release.

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Issue:** The payments service is `payments-api`. It was running v5.1.0 (deployed this morning) and was unhealthy across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
- **Rollback:** Rolled back to **v5.0.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The rollback completed in all regions.
- **Verification:** Service is now healthy at v5.0.0 with a 0.2% error rate.
- **Incident:** Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for the v5.1.0 regression; the on-call engineer has been paged.
